landing.title: Qio
landing.documentTitle: Qio — In-person queues, nothing to install
landing.metaDescription: Create your venue’s queue and get a QR code. Customers join from the browser with no app, follow their position in real time and are notified when it is their turn.

hero.sub: Customers scan the QR code and join the queue from the browser. You call the next one from the app.
hero.note: For customers: no account, no app, no sign-up.

client.title: Those who wait stay in the loop.

steps.b: The counter’s QR code opens the queue right in the browser. Enter a name and you are in: no account, no app.
Ticket, position and estimated wait stay on screen and update on their own, in real time.
Full screen, sound and vibration when the ticket is called. Nobody misses a turn watching the counter.

owner.title: Those who serve stay in control.

steps.t: Create the queue, print the QR.
steps.b: In minutes you have the queue, a short link and a poster in your brand color.
Next, call again, served or no-show. Operators join with an invite code.
Customers served, average wait, no-shows and peak hours for each queue.

care.title: Built with care

items.b: Just a name and, optionally, a phone. Access is anonymous.
The number stays with the venue. Other customers never see it.
Visits and ratings are deleted after 180 days by default.
The owner finds, exports and erases a customer’s data by phone.
